fg_shaders.inc is generated from the SPIR-V of the shaders in Swordpdf's ps5-framegen (shaders/, tools/build-shaders.sh):
AMD FidelityFX SDK 2.3.0's optical flow and frame interpolation passes, some cut down for RPCS3-PS5. That folder's
LICENSE.txt, which covers them and this file, follows.

The files in this directory come from AMD FidelityFX SDK 2.3.0 ("FSR SDK 2.3.0"), Kits/FidelityFX, some of them modified for
RPCS3-PS5 (see README.md). The SDK's docs/license.md puts each of them (api/internal/gpu/*.h, framegeneration/fsr3/include/gpu/**
and framegeneration/fsr3/internal/shaders/ffx_opticalflow_*.hlsl) under the license below, and their own headers say the same. The
fg_fi_*.hlsl passes are RPCS3-PS5's, cut down from the SDK's passes of the same purpose, under the same license.
